promise_band.headline: The Crew On Your Roof Works For Us
promise_band.body: Most roofing companies in this region sell the job and then hand it to whichever subcontractor is free that week. We have never worked that way. Every installer at MNM is on our payroll and was trained by Miguel, and every job is his responsibility from the estimate through the final sweep of the yard. That is why we can put a 10-year workmanship warranty in writing — there is nobody else to point at if something is not right.

signature_system.headline: Doing It Right Beats Doing It Fast
signature_system.intro: Whether it is a full metal roof on a lake house or a single storm repair in Nanticoke, every MNM job runs the same way — the same crew, the same warranty, and the same person accountable for it.

blocks.title: We document the storm damage properly
blocks.body: Storms hide their damage. We assess the whole roof — including structural weakness and leaks you cannot see from the ground — and write the detailed report your insurer will ask for. We work directly with adjusters, and we will tarp during the storm if it cannot wait.

blocks.title: See the materials before you commit
blocks.body: Our Greentown office has a full roofing showroom — premium shingle lines, metal panel profiles, gutter systems and colour samples all on display. Come look at what is going on your house instead of picking it off a screen. Whatever you choose, the replacement carries a 10-year workmanship warranty plus our 15-year craftsman warranty.

about_block.headline: Family-Owned, Built On Not Cutting Corners
about_block.body: Before Miguel Cornejo opened MNM, he spent years subcontracting for large regional roofing companies — learning the best of what each one did, and seeing plenty of what he would never do himself. He founded MNM in Nanticoke in 2018. Today the main hub is in Greentown serving the Poconos, with a second office back in Nanticoke for Luzerne County and a growing Lehigh Valley presence in Whitehall Township. Every installer is a qualified craftsman personally trained by Miguel, working alongside him on the job.

seo_body.headline: Roofing Built For Northeast Pennsylvania Weather
paragraphs: Roofs in this part of Pennsylvania take a beating that roofs further south never see. Freeze-thaw cycles work at flashing all winter, ice dams push water back up under the shingles, heavy snow loads sit on low-slope sections for weeks, and summer storms come through the Poconos with enough wind to lift a poorly nailed course clean off.

We install shingle systems fortified by Owens Corning warranties, energy-efficient metal roofing including Tilcor stone-coated steel, and rubber membrane for flat and low-slope structures — each specified for those conditions rather than for a catalogue. Gutters are sized to the roof's actual pitch and area so meltwater has somewhere to go before it reaches your foundation.

faqs.q: How do I get a free estimate?
faqs.a: Request one through this site or call (570) 793-5715. Miguel, the owner, personally oversees every estimate — he gets on the roof, documents what he finds, and gives you an itemised written number. There is no charge and no obligation.

No. Every installer on your roof is on MNM's payroll and was personally trained by Miguel. That is the whole reason we can back the work with a written workmanship warranty — there is no third party to hand the blame to.

faqs.q: What warranty comes with a full roof replacement?
faqs.a: A 10-year workmanship warranty covering labour and installation, plus our 15-year craftsman warranty from the in-house team. The manufacturer's material warranty sits on top of that — Owens Corning on shingle systems, and 50-year coverage on Tilcor stone-coated steel.

faqs.q: Do you handle insurance claims for storm damage?
faqs.a: Yes, routinely. We assess the full extent of the damage including hidden leaks and structural weakness, produce the detailed report insurers require, and work directly with your adjuster. If the roof cannot wait, we will tarp it first.

faqs.q: Are you licensed and insured in Pennsylvania?
faqs.a: Yes. MNM Roofing Professionals is licensed in Pennsylvania under PA154140, and we are bonded and insured. We are also BBB accredited with an A+ rating.

faqs.q: Do you install gutters as well as roofs?
faqs.a: Yes — seamless gutters, downspouts and leaf guards for both homes and commercial buildings. Book a full roof and gutters together and the leaf guards are included free.
